page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with a woodcut device below the text and the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: ipsaque ad nostri aevi usum accommodatis,

page.notes: Mirrored, faint lines across the top of the page are show-through from the reverse and are omitted. The woodcut device (a seated figure within a circular inscription) in the centre is not transcribed. The Bayerische Staatsbibliothek stamp at the bottom is omitted. Several lines in the lower half of the title (the Tacitus subtitle and the Latin lines after "MEDULLA") are only partly legible at this scan quality; the marked readings are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The line "PROFESSORIS" is partly legible and its remainder is marked illegible.
